name: Mailchimp
verdict: Self-serve: register an app and run OAuth, with no review documented, in about 1-3 days. Marketplace listing is optional and goes through the Integration Partner Program.
needGuide: Short one: register the app, redirect users to authorize, exchange the code.

auth.detail: Authorization-code flow: authorize at https://login.mailchimp.com/oauth2/authorize, exchange at https://login.mailchimp.com/oauth2/token. Access tokens have no expiry and there is no refresh token; a token stays valid until the user revokes or is removed. After auth, call https://login.mailchimp.com/oauth2/metadata (header Authorization: OAuth <token>) to get dc, api_endpoint and login_url, since each account lives on a data center like us19 (metadata endpoint from general knowledge; the pages read did not show it).

approval.gate: None for connecting customers: registering an app is enough and the docs describe no review. Mailchimp Marketplace listing is optional, requires OAuth, and goes through the Integration Partner Program (requirements not read).

scopes.why: No scope parameter; the token likely acts with the user's access to the whole account.
scopes.summary: The OAuth guides read show no scope parameter; the token acts with the authorizing user's access to the whole account (likely, unconfirmed). There are no scope-based review gates.

cost: Free to register; customers need their own Mailchimp account (plan limits apply to their audiences)
prerequisites: Account and owner: A user with a Mailchimp login on a company-owned account to register the app; the secret can be rotated from the same page if exposed.
Where you register: Mailchimp account -> Registered Apps (OAuth2) -> Register An App -> fill form -> Create; copy client_id and client_secret (secret shown once)
Cost: Free to register; customers need their own Mailchimp account (plan limits apply to their audiences)

registerAt.path: Mailchimp account -> Registered Apps (OAuth2) -> Register An App -> fill form -> Create; copy client_id and client_secret (secret shown once)

steps.do: Log in as the company Mailchimp user; open Registered Apps and click Register An App; enter name, description, company, HTTPS redirect URI
Copy client_id and client_secret to a secret manager (secret shown once)
POST the code to /oauth2/token with grant_type=authorization_code, client_id, client_secret, redirect_uri to get access_token
Call /oauth2/metadata to read dc and api_endpoint; store them per customer and call https://<dc>.api.mailchimp.com/3.0/
On 401 treat the token as revoked and ask the user to reconnect; delete stored tokens and sync configs on disconnect

roles.team: A user with a Mailchimp login on a company-owned account to register the app; the secret can be rotated from the same page if exposed.
roles.console: none documented; app registration belongs to the Mailchimp user who registered it, so share via a company login.
roles.customer: A Mailchimp user with access to the account approves in the consent screen; the token carries that user's access. Which user roles may authorize apps was not documented (likely Admin or Owner is safest).

testing: Use your own Mailchimp account (free tier) plus a second account as a stand-in customer; http://127.0.0.1 redirect URIs work for local development.

blockers.problem: Hard-coding a data center fails for other customers
blockers.fix: Always read dc from the metadata endpoint.

blockers.problem: Client secret is shown only once

blockers.fix: A 401 means revoked and a full re-authorization is required.

blockers.problem: Marketplace listing requires OAuth plus Integration Partner Program steps not documented here

automation.agentCan: Write the full OAuth, metadata and API client code, handle revocation, run test calls, draft listing copy.
automation.humanMust: Log in to register the app, store the secret, and apply to the Integration Partner Program if listing is wanted.

uncertain: Metadata endpoint details, who can register apps, role needed to authorize, and Marketplace requirements were not on the pages read.
